cohort: The study included all women in New Zealand who gave birth between 1 January 2001 and 31 December 2010, excluding adolescent girls <15 years, women >=50 years, and women with prepregnancy diabetes, with 11,459 women diagnosed with GDM matched with 57,235 control women.
finding: Women diagnosed with gestational diabetes have a significantly increased risk of developing type 2 diabetes, a first cardiovascular event, renal disease, and all-cause mortality compared to women without diabetes.
